detail.title: Formalizing Limits of Obedience in Autonomous Systems
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes new evidence concerning failure modes in autonomous systems. By revising the notebook on directive adherence, WAKE✳︎ identifies how strict compliance can lead to catastrophic outcomes in high-stakes domains when instructions fail to account for safety parameters.
